nodes.description: Admin address stored in CTokenStorage; controls privileged setters such as _setImplementation.
Pending administrator transfer target held in storage, reached through delegated admin functions.
Implementation address from CDelegationStorage; used as the target of every delegatecall made by the delegator.
Comptroller reference stored by the delegator/proxy and mutated through delegated admin calls.
Constructor: sets admin = msg.sender, performs the initial delegateTo initialize call, calls _setImplementation, and then hands admin to admin_.
_setImplementation: admin-gated setter that rewrites the implementation storage slot and delegates resign/become hooks.
delegateTo: internal primitive executing callee.delegatecall(data) and bubbling up revert data via assembly.
delegateToImplementation: PUBLIC function that delegatecalls the stored implementation with caller-supplied bytes data.
delegateToViewImplementation: public view that staticcalls delegateToImplementation on address(this).
delegateToViewAndReturn: private view that staticcalls address(this) and returns raw returndata through inline assembly.
delegateAndReturn: private function performing implementation.delegatecall(msg.data) and returning raw returndata via assembly.
Fallback payable function: requires msg.value == 0 and forwards all calldata through delegateAndReturn.
mint: external entry point that suppresses its argument and delegates execution to the implementation.
redeem: external entry point that delegates execution to the implementation.
borrow: external entry point that delegates execution to the implementation.
liquidateBorrow: external entry point taking borrower, repayAmount and collateral token, then delegating.
seize: external entry point that delegates collateral seizure to the implementation.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used for admin assignment in the constructor and for admin checks in _setImplementation.
Raw low-level delegatecall inside delegateTo (callee.delegatecall(data)) with no whitelist and no success precheck.
Raw low-level delegatecall inside delegateAndReturn (implementation.delegatecall(msg.data)) executing arbitrary implementation code in this contract's storage context.
Low-level staticcall on address(this) inside delegateToViewAndReturn/ delegateToViewImplementation with assembly returndata handling.
implementation_ parameter of _setImplementation; becomes the delegatecall target address for the whole proxy.
allowResign boolean parameter of _setImplementation gating the _resignImplementation delegatecall.
becomeImplementationData bytes parameter of _setImplementation forwarded into the delegated _becomeImplementation call.
data bytes parameter of delegateTo carrying the calldata forwarded to the delegatecall.
callee address parameter of delegateTo used as the delegatecall destination.
oldImplementation local variable in _setImplementation caching the previous implementation for the NewImplementation event.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns admin = msg.sender, so the deployer immediately holds unrestricted admin rights.
_setImplementation is gated by require(msg.sender == admin), making the untrusted caller the sole authorization input.
implementation_ parameter overwrites the implementation storage slot that governs every delegatecall target.
delegateToImplementation reads the implementation storage slot directly as the delegatecall target.
The stored implementation address is the target of the raw delegatecall in delegateAndReturn.
delegateTo body executes the low-level delegatecall operation.
callee parameter supplies the destination address of the delegatecall.
data parameter supplies the calldata consumed by delegateTo.
delegateToImplementation forwards to delegateTo(implementation, data).
Admin-supplied implementation_ is routed through delegateToImplementation during installation.
delegateAndReturn transfers control to the implementation contract, which executes inside this contract and can call back in.
delegateToViewAndReturn performs the low-level staticcall on address(this).
delegateToViewImplementation staticcalls address(this) which re-enters delegateToImplementation with its own calldata.
Constructor performs the initial delegateTo initialize call on the supplied implementation.
Constructor calls _setImplementation to install the first implementation before handing over admin.
_setImplementation invokes delegateToImplementation for the resign and become hooks.
_setImplementation writes the new implementation address into storage, redirecting all future delegatecalls.
oldImplementation local variable captures the previous implementation storage value.
The admin-controlled implementation_ ultimately becomes the target of the raw delegatecall in delegateAndReturn.
allowResign controls whether the _resignImplementation delegatecall is issued.
becomeImplementationData is encoded and forwarded as delegatecall calldata to the implementation.
mint ignores its argument and delegates execution via delegateAndReturn.
redeem delegates execution to the implementation via delegateAndReturn.
borrow delegates execution to the implementation via delegateAndReturn.
liquidateBorrow delegates execution to the implementation via delegateAndReturn.
seize delegates execution to the implementation via delegateAndReturn.
Fallback forwards arbitrary msg.data through delegateAndReturn, letting any caller trigger an implementation delegatecall.
The delegatecall inside _setImplementation executes external implementation code in this contract's storage context, where admin and implementation live.
The implementation reached by delegatecall can re-enter this contract through the payable fallback and its delegate path.

normalization_plan.reason: implementation_ is the direct argument of _setImplementation and defines the delegatecall target it installs.
allowResign is consumed only by _setImplementation to branch on _resignImplementation.
becomeImplementationData is used only by _setImplementation as the delegated _becomeImplementation payload.
data is the sole calldata argument of delegateTo and feeds its delegatecall.
callee is the sole address argument of delegateTo and becomes the delegatecall destination.
oldImplementation is a short-lived local inside _setImplementation used only for the NewImplementation event.
